I'm weighing whether a trade with p1 could net me St Charles or States Avenue in exchange for New York.

Trading New York to p1 would hand them the orange monopoly, risky but p1's cash is tight enough to slow their building. I'll instead try offering cash for St James and Tennessee — maybe $450 — to lock up oranges myself, expecting p1 might balk but it's worth proposing.
